newsitem.title: USA: CSCE WORLD SUGAR ENDS BARELY DOWN IN THIN TRADE.
newsitem.headline: CSCE WORLD SUGAR ENDS BARELY DOWN IN THIN TRADE.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures closed barely lower after setting the range early in the day and then drifting amid light volume.
An estimated 16,522 lots changed hands on the day compared with Tuesday's official 7,703 lots.
Traders said speculative buying carried prices through resistance at 11.55 cents and to the high of 11.58 cents basis October.
Speculative liquidation at the highs pressured the spot month below unchanged and to the low of 11.41 cents, still above support seen at the recent low of 11.32 cents.
Losses were blamed on weak technicals and a lack of substantial physical offtake, market sources said.
The spot October contract settled 0.02 cent weaker at 11.49 cents a lb, having ranged from 11.58 to 11.41 cents. The rest of the board finished 0.02 cent lower to 0.04 cent firmer.
Strong resistance remained at the recent high of 11.87 cents.
